caption: Figure 6B. Annual chronological national dispatch for 2040 Slow, 2050 Slow, 2040 Base, 2050 Base, 2040 High, 2050 High. The accepted annual_dispatch_chronological_daily producer supplies 365 calendar-day interval means using physical interval overlap, its technology groups, semantic colours and Variant D signed areas. Imports and exports are split before averaging; charging, P2X and exports appear below zero. Storage discharge and nonphysical shedding remain distinct from primary generation. The black line is rigid demand. Means are presentation only; annual energy, extrema and statistics retain all 8,760 saved 2019 weather hours. Final publication baselines: 2040 final_v3 and 2050 final_v6.
